rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps findings to OWASP and NIST for regulatory audit evidence.
rationale.ai-review: Multiple LLM agents detect vulnerabilities and comparatively review code findings.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Standards mappings, root causes, recommendations, and reports support auditor judgment.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Predefined checkpoints let auditors select models, validate, verify, and edit findings.
rationale.framework: Reusable multi-agent RAG architecture integrates detection, mapping, and audit reporting.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and tested a working web-based Code Prism prototype.
rationale.expert-validated: Two security auditors and two UX specialists formally reviewed the artifact.
rationale.general-code: The reviewed DVNA code was not identified as AI-generated.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluation substantively measures vulnerability detection coverage across security severity levels.
rationale.method-experiment: Validators performed assigned repository-analysis tasks under standardized model settings.
